title: Repository licensing: PolyForm Noncommercial and AI-training reservation

completion_criteria.text: Establish the actual licensing state of the repo and what third parties may and may not do with it
Choose a license satisfying attribution and noncommercial restriction, with the open-source trade-off made explicitly
Add LICENSE and NOTICE carrying the PolyForm terms, the TDM reservation, and the kickstart.nvim MIT carve-out
Express the AI-training reservation in machine-readable form (robots.txt, ai.txt, tdmrep.json)
Remove the false MIT claim from README and declare the license in package.json
Open a PR to main and drive all CI checks green
Merge the PR to main so the license is in effect on the default branch
Diagnose the nondeterministic secret-scan CI failure rather than accepting a re-run as the fix

spine.active_goal: Put the PolyForm Noncommercial license and the AI-training reservation into effect on main, then activate the EU reservation by mirroring to an owned domain.
spine.next_step: Merge PR #62, a human action since agents are denied merge at the bash gate by design. After merge, decide whether to pursue the self-hosted mirror, which is the step that actually activates the EU Art. 4(3) mechanism; the committed robots.txt, ai.txt and tdmrep.json are inert while the project is GitHub-hosted.
spine.last_session: Established the repo was public with no license at all, chose PolyForm Noncommercial over AGPL, and shipped LICENSE/NOTICE plus the machine-readable TDM trio and the README/package.json corrections in 3 atomic commits. PR #62 is green on all 7 checks, awaiting a human merge.

open_risks.text: treat the license as not yet in effect until PR #62 is merged — until then main is still the unlicensed all-rights-reserved state this work set out to fix

re-verify branch-local facts after any checkout — this session asserted a CI gate that exists only on an unmerged branch and nearly shipped an orphan receipt, because a file read is only true of the tree it came from
do not present the machine-readable opt-out files as active protection while the repo is GitHub-hosted — crawlers fetch github.com/robots.txt rather than the repository's copy
read the secret-scan log before hunting for a leak — the gitleaks action calls api.github.com to classify the account and fails closed when that call breaks, so it can go red with no secret present
refs: run 31465362753 failed and run 31465330001 passed on the same commit

key_decisions.title: Trade the OSI open-source label for the noncommercial restriction
Express the AI-training refusal in machine-readable form, not license prose alone

out_of_scope: Formal copyright registration or obtaining legal counsel - this work is a factual read of the repository's licensing state and the options available, not legal advice.

Relicensing the kickstart.nvim-derived material under .config/nvim/ - that upstream MIT grant runs directly from its own authors and cannot be revoked or narrowed from this repository; .config/nvim/LICENSE.md must stay in place.
Changing the terms that apply to forks taken before this change - the relicense governs forward only.
